_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Theme Settings mapping docs. Hand-curated from the Site Converter's design-system extraction (class-fw-site-converter-stitch.php build_color_presets / typography / button logic + class-fw-site-converter-theme-settings.php importer) cross-referenced against the theme's option groups (unysonplus-theme/framework-customizations/theme/options/*.php, documented in theme-settings-reference.md). Edit THIS file, then run `node scripts/gen-theme-settings-mapping.mjs` to regenerate ai-dev-kit/theme-settings-mapping/*.md. Do NOT hand-edit the generated .md. Option 'status': native = derived from a source signal; via-css = reproduced via generated CSS, native option empty; unmapped = left at default (no source signal / manual); auto = plumbing. Tab 'coverage': populated = the converter writes this tab; partial = only some keys; manual = not converter-populated (set by hand or by the generated child theme).

native.label: Native
native.blurb: Derived and written from a source signal.

via-css.label: Via CSS
via-css.blurb: Reproduced via generated CSS; the native option is left empty (candidate to promote).

unmapped.label: Unmapped
unmapped.blurb: Left at default — no source signal, or set by hand.

auto.label: Auto
auto.blurb: Plumbing. Excluded from the coverage percentage.

tabs.intro: The Colors tab is the site **palette** — the `theme_colors` addable list of `{ name, color }` rows. Each row's name becomes a slug that drives a `.text-{slug}` / `.bg-{slug}` utility and a `--color-{slug}` CSS variable (e.g. **Primary** drives `btn-primary` + `--color-primary`). The converter derives the source's **brand palette** and writes these rows, then merges the plugin's default presets after them (de-duped by hex) so bundled Box / Icon-Badge presets that reference default slugs still resolve.
tabs.recognizerNotes: Brand colours are pulled from the captured design tokens (a real `tailwind.config`) first, then from each element's computed `getComputedStyle` semantic colours, then a markup accent scan / a gradient-accent scan / the primary button's real fill; body text falls back to a sampled ink colour. A brand role only appears when a real colour was found — otherwise the default palette stands. The brand `Primary` is prepended before the default `Primary`, so it wins the `primary` slug and the default button/box presets adopt the brand colour.

options.source: Brand action colour, in priority order: `tailwind.config` accent/primary token → computed semantic primary/accent → vivid markup accent scan → the primary button's real fill → tertiary/secondary/ink → neutral fallback. Wins the `primary` slug (drives `btn-primary` + `--color-primary`).
Source text / foreground colour (`text`, `on-background`, `foreground`), or — when no token exists — **sampled from the real rendered body-copy colour** (`sample_ink`). Falls back to `#1a1a1a`.
`secondary` / `tertiary` token, or the computed semantic `secondary`. Only when found.

Computed semantic `accent`, or — when the design has no named accent — an accent colour **lifted from a source gradient** (`scan_gradient_accent`, e.g. the vivid stop in a hero gradient). Only when found.
`deep-black` / `black` / `surface-container-lowest` token, or semantic `dark`. Only when found.
The plugin's ~20 default color presets, merged in after the brand roles and de-duped by hex — kept (not derived) so bundled Box / Icon-Badge presets that reference their slugs keep resolving.

tabs.storageKey: button_presets · box_presets · text_styles · theme_colors · image_styles · section_style_presets · …
tabs.intro: Components is where the converter reproduces the source’s **design system** most heavily. It’s a single Theme Settings tab, but it holds many **preset libraries** — buttons, boxes, text styles, colours, badges, image styles, section skins, spacing — and the converter **derives almost all of them** from the captured DOM + computed styles, writing each as a fully-editable **addable-box** (not baked CSS).
tabs.recognizerNotes: These presets are what the converted **elements** then consume — a button points at a derived Button preset, a card at a derived Box preset, a heading at a derived Text Style — so editing one preset restyles every element that uses it, site-wide. Each library below has its own page here (what the converter fills) and a full reference under **[The Theme → Components](/theme/components)** (how it’s coded + examples).

presets.name: Buttons
presets.intro: From the source’s real button skin (`build_button_presets`) — the fill, text colour, border, radius, padding and shadow of the actual buttons, plus S / M / L **size** presets. A Large size preset also repoints the header CTA so it matches the source’s chunky button.

options.source: Width / style / colour when the source button has one
X / Y padding → informs the size presets
Only carried when it **deviates** from the body base font; otherwise inherited for free
Distinct button sizes clustered from the source

presets.name: Box Presets
presets.intro: Reusable card / box skins clustered from the source (`build_box_presets`) — every repeated “card” look becomes one editable Box preset.

presets.name: Text Styles
presets.intro: The **display scale** + eyebrow distilled from the source’s headings and paragraphs (`build_text_styles`) — the Display / Lead / Small roles the elements consume (this is where the type scale lands, not the Typography tab’s per-heading overrides).

options.source: Distinct heading / display sizes from the source
The small uppercase label pattern when the source uses one

presets.name: Color Presets
presets.intro: The source’s brand palette (`build_color_presets`, from the extracted tokens + the DOM) → editable Components colours the whole site references by name.

options.source: The distinct brand colours found in the source

presets.name: Icon Badges
presets.intro: The source’s icon-in-a-tile pattern (`build_icon_badge_presets`) → editable badge presets (the coloured square/circle behind a feature icon).

presets.name: Image Styles
presets.intro: Radius / circle / aspect / filter from the source’s images (`build_image_styles`) → reusable image treatments.

options.source: Fully-round crop when the source uses it

presets.name: Section Styles
presets.intro: Reusable band skins clustered from the source’s sections (`build_section_style_presets`) — a repeated section look becomes one editable Section Style.

presets.name: Container Widths
presets.intro: Named content-band widths gathered from the source (`build_container_width_presets`) — Narrow / Medium / Wide plus any distinct widths the site uses, so converted sections reference **shared named widths** instead of one-off numbers.

options.source: Any extra widths the source uses, added as named presets

presets.name: Background Patterns
presets.intro: Captured SVG / gradient decorative tiles (`build_background_patterns`, the PHP parity of the JS `backgroundPatterns()`); the mapper injects the matching overlay onto its section.

options.source: The decorative pattern lifted from the source
The mapper wires the pattern onto the section that used it

presets.name: Spacing
presets.intro: The source’s spacing steps → an editable scale (`build_spacing_scale`), so the converted site carries a real scale instead of the theme default.

options.source: The distinct spacing values the source uses

presets.name: Gaps
presets.intro: The source’s column / grid gutters → an editable gap scale (`build_gap_scale`) — mirrors the extended default and appends any off-scale gutter **exactly** (a `gap-[20px]` gets an exact entry, no snap).

options.source: The default scale plus the source’s gutters

tabs.intro: The Typography tab sets the site fonts and type scale. The converter derives the **heading font family** and writes it to `typography.heading_font`; the **body font** is enforced by the generated child theme’s scoped CSS.
tabs.recognizerNotes: The type **scale** the converter distils from the source headings and paragraphs is written to the shortcodes’ **[Text Styles](/theme/components/text-styles)** component (the Display / Lead / Small roles), **not** the per-heading overrides on this tab. Link colours and per-heading size overrides are left at the theme defaults.

options.source: Heading font family, from the source headings → `typography.heading_font`
Body font enforced by the generated child-theme CSS (`body { font-family … }`); the native family may stay “inherit”
Per-heading size overrides — the type scale goes to Components → Text Styles instead
Non-Google fonts are not registered here automatically

tabs.location: Theme Settings → General → Layout (Site Background) · per-Section · Footer
tabs.intro: A background detector runs across the **body**, each **section**, and the **footer**, and writes the fills it finds — colour, gradient, photo, or video.
tabs.recognizerNotes: The body background is written **once** as a global Theme Setting (`general_layout.site_background`) so the whole site inherits it, and the theme-generator emits `body { background-color: var(--site-bg-color, …) }` **without** `!important` so a later edit still wins. Background **videos** are side-loaded to the Media Library so they stay editable in the Background → Video picker. Per-section band fills live on each **Section** element, not on a Theme Setting.

options.source: The body background — colour / gradient / image, written once as a global setting
Per-section colour / gradient / photo / video — stored on each Section, not Theme Settings

tabs.intro: The Layout tab controls the overall canvas — site width, container width, spacing density, roundness. The converter carries the **content container width** so body sections match the source; the rest is left for you to tune.
tabs.recognizerNotes: The source’s content max-width is written to `general_layout.layout_container_width` (the desktop value) so converted body sections finally line up with the source. Width mode, gutter, content density and roundness are left at the theme defaults.

options.source: Source content max-width → the desktop container width
Written by the background detector — see the Backgrounds tab

tabs.intro: The Footer tab styles the footer band. The converter derives the footer’s **background fill** and **muted text colour**; the structural chrome (columns, menus, widgets) comes from the generated child theme + captured menus.
tabs.recognizerNotes: The footer background and text colour come from `detect_footer_style()`. The footer’s rows / columns / menus are built by the generated child theme and the captured menus (see [Header & Footer Elements](/theme/header-footer-elements)), not these design keys.

options.source: Built by the generated child theme + captured menus, not these keys

otherTabs.note: Selection / scrollbar / focus colours — opt-in, set by hand.
Behavioural / structural defaults — not derived from a source design.

otherTabs.tab: Header (Identity, Layout, Top/Bottom bar, Menu, Mega Menu…)
otherTabs.note: The header chrome comes from the generated child theme + captured menus, not Theme Settings design keys.
Post/archive layout defaults — not part of a page conversion.
